title: A ほど～ない — not as ～ as A
summary: Says that something does not reach the level of a standard of comparison. 'A は B ほど ～ない' means A is less ～ than B. The predicate must be negative.

patterns.gloss: A は B ほど + negative adjective/verb

body.p: B is the standard and A falls short of it. It follows nouns and the plain form of verbs and adjectives; 思ったほど (as much as I thought) is very common. The predicate must be negative: ～ない, ～ではない, ～なかった.
Close to AはBより～ない, but ほど carries a feeling of 'not to that extent.' A positive predicate does not make the comparison; positive ほど is the 'extent' pattern.

examples.ja: 今年（ことし）は去年（きょねん）ほど暑（あつ）くない。
examples.tr: This year is not as hot as last year.

examples.ja: 私（わたし）は姉（あね）ほど料理（りょうり）が上手（じょうず）ではない。
examples.romaji: Watashi wa ane hodo ryōri ga jōzu de wa nai.
examples.tr: I'm not as good at cooking as my older sister.

examples.ja: この問題（もんだい）は思（おも）ったほど難（むずか）しくなかった。
examples.romaji: Kono mondai wa omotta hodo muzukashikunakatta.
examples.tr: This problem wasn't as difficult as I had thought.

pitfalls: The predicate must be negative. 去年ほど暑い does not make a comparison.
B, the standard, is the higher one. Do not reverse the order.
